description: A plain rank-and-file chinese spearman in the supplied pixel art style. A round grey iron helmet with a small knob, grey lamellar armor with pale trim, cream sleeves, dark bracers, a red neck scarf, a red waist sash with a red front cloth, dark boots with a tan band. He holds a plain spear with a small steel leaf-shaped head and a brown shaft
face: A stern face with a short grey beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the round grey helmet, dark hair under its rim, the red scarf, grey lamellar armor, the red sash, the spear at his right side. Nothing hangs on his back.
guard_action: both hands take the spear and bring it to a ready angle at the right side, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.idle: Spearman fighting guard, spear held in both hands, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the spear, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.pa1: One straight spear thrust. Frames 1-5 the spear is drawn back at the right hip; frames 6-8 a step forward and a straight thrust, point first; frames 9-11 hold the reach. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.pb1: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the whole upper body winds far to the right with the spear held level; frames 7-8 the spear swings around from the side to the front in a wide flat arc; frames 9-11 hold in front. The spear travels sideways, not a thrust. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.pb2: VERTICAL overhead spear strike. Frames 3-6 both hands raise the spear straight up above the head, pointing at the sky; frames 7-8 it is brought down from above onto the target; frames 9-11 hold with the tip low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.pa3: Leaping downward spear strike. Frames 1-4 he sinks; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground with the spear over the right shoulder; frame 8 he lands driving the spear down; frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 pa1 → pb1 → pb2, 전법 pa3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 기본 병종. 밋밋한 클립(p)만 쓴다. 늘어지는 천이 없어 streamers 없음.
